items.title: Result of Certificate course on Certificate course on Forex and Treasury management (FXTM) held on 13th June 2026. -
Extension of timeline with respect to compliance of Digital Accessibility Circulars
Rationalisation of periodicity of KYC review for FPIs
Extension of timeline for compliance with terms and conditions by Debenture Trustees (DTs) for carrying out activities outside the purview of SEBI
Review of regulatory requirement for maintenance of call records of institutional clients by Research Analysts or Research Entities
Margin Waiver on Subsequent Buy/Sell Transactions Post Early Pay-In (EPI) in Cash Segment
Review of certain aspects of the Closing Auction Session, market timings and settlement methodology for derivatives contracts
Introduction of Credit Risk-o-Meter as an additional disclosure mechanism for debt securities
Exemption from the requirement of mandatory merchant banker appointment for debt issued through private placement by certain listed issuers
Review of provisions related to International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) for debt securities issued on private placement basis
Display of “investor awareness message(s)” by stock brokers on their trading apps and websites, under Project Jagrook
Review of Position Limits for Clients and Penalty Provisions for Violation / Breach of Position Limits for Commodity Derivatives Segment
